response.sql: SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow

assumptions.assumption: Execution count is COUNT(*) of all matched executions per status, including executions with NULL fillcount. The average ignores NULL fillcount, as requested.
The total for the fraction is the number of matched executions across all statuses. Executions with no matching order are excluded from both the numerator and the denominator.
Orders with a NULL orderflow form their own group, shown with a NULL status.
